- So the player is at cols 40-43, needs to be at cols 36-39: LEFT once, then SPACE.

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
action(['LEFT','SPACE'], intent='solve')
r = last_action_result

def snap(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','W','b','c','G','g'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'], min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)))
    return out
print('now:', snap(current_frame))

</function>
